answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while correlated equivocation links signatures, timing, and funding across identities. For k coordinated identities, the penalty grows quadratically, O(k^2), so a sybil swarm rapidly exhausts shared backing; upon detection, an exponential multiplier further increases capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation reducing residual value. A jetty, walnut, or knoll cannot conceal common control or restore slashed stake.
